# Synthetic page inventory boundary

`empty-root.xml` is an original synthetic XML fixture licensed under the repository MIT license.
It declares pages 7, 42 and 99, two resistors on the child pages, and an empty root.
The intermediate path `/Other/` is not a declared page. No third-party source was copied.
The tests derive explicit rejection variants (duplicate identity, missing number/path,
invalid scope) and a metadata-absent limited variant. Total authored fixture data is below 200 KB.
These inputs test document inventory and ledger obligations, not electrical approval.
